items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: we would play W. C. Handy's "St. Louis Blues"

ctx.x: We had enough head arrangements to tear up the house. We had St. Louis Blues." Sometime we'd open up with one of the bands and sometime we used to --
When we come off for intermission, we would play W. C. Handy's "St. Louis Blues" and other head arrangements (Inaudible).
Sometimes we used to open with that. People used to say, And (Inaudible), "What they gonna play now, they opened with that?"
